title: Pure Amazoness
summary: Amazoness cards with the Polymerization they search, plus generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Amazoness Princess counts as Amazoness Queen, searches an Amazoness Spell/Trap, and pulls an Amazoness from the Deck when it attacks. The 2022 cards lead. Amazoness War Chief summons itself and Sets an Amazoness Spell/Trap or Polymerization from the Deck. Amazoness Spiritualist returns an Amazoness card to summon itself and searches Polymerization. Golden Whip Master and Silver Sword Master move to the Pendulum Zone when they fall, and from there they pump Amazoness monsters, destroy a Spell/Trap or recover one when an Amazoness attacks. Amazoness Secret Arts Fusion Summons on either turn. Amazoness Augusta protects every other Amazoness card and summons one from the Deck. Amazoness Hot Spring and Amazoness Hall fetch monsters or Pendulums. Spiritualist limits the Extra Deck to Amazoness for the turn.

allow.Polymerization: Amazoness Spiritualist and Amazoness War Chief search or Set it.
